headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Commerce Department if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Commerce Department officials would step in to act as Secretary of Commerce if the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are absent, have died, or cannot do the job. It is an internal rule about who is in charge during a vacancy. No summary was provided, so the exact order of officials is not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Commerce
who_it_affects.how: It sets the order in which they would temporarily take on the duties of the Secretary of Commerce if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: May 21, 2012 (date signed); the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
